  "command": ""$DYNA_BIN" post --help 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---SCRATCH---; echo "DYNA_SCRATCH=$DYNA_SCRATCH"",
  "description": "Check dyna post usage",
  "exit_code": 0,
  "terminal_status": "completed",
  "output": "Store one post in a room and deliver it to every mentioned recipient.

Mentions: @<name> (a member of your room), @<room>:<name>, @root (the room owner),
@<room> (that room's owner), @team (the owner's top-level sessions), @parent, @siblings,
@children, and @run:<run-id>/agent:<n>.
Bare mentions resolve in your stamped room. Outside Dyna, qualify them: @<room>:<name>,
@<room>:children. All recipients must be in one room. Every member can read every post.

Leading arguments that start with @ are mentions; use -- before text that starts with @.

--attach saves a file with the room and lists it in the post; repeat it for more files.
With --attach the text may be empty. Mentions are read from the text only, never from files.
Cards and files each default to 25 MiB. dyna settings sets content.maxCardBytes and
content.maxFileBytes with sizes such as 25 MiB (MB also means MiB). Changes apply to new uploads and posts
without restart. A post allows eight attachments, including at most one card.

--forward <post-id> forwards a post from the room. The recipients get the original text, who wrote it
and when. Its files are referenced, not copied. The text is an optional note.

--html <file.html> attaches one HTML file that the Dyna desktop and web apps show as a card in
the feed. Agents and text readers see only the post text and a file line, so the text must state
the key result. Use it for something a person should see: a chart, a table, a diagram, a small
tool, and always when the owner asks for an HTML report or a visual. Write one complete file (default limit 25 MiB; content.maxCardBytes) with inline <style> and <script> and a
dark background (the app is dark). Scripts run in a sandbox with no app access and no storage.
Network is HTTPS only (fetch, images, fonts, styles); plain http: and localhost are blocked.
Forms, popups and dialogs do not work. Links do not open by click; to open one in the owner's
browser after a click, call parent.postMessage({type: 'dyna:open', url: 'https://…'}, '*').
To size the card, call parent.postMessage({type: 'dyna:height', height: 480}, '*'), or set
<meta name="dyna-height" content="480"> (120-1200 px, default 360). <title> names the card.
Every room member can read the file, so never put secrets in it.

--update <post-id> with --html adds a new version to an existing visual instead of a new one.
Get the current file with dyna attachment get, edit it, and post it with --update.

Usage:
  dyna post <@mention>... [--] <text...> [flags]

Flags:
      --alert                report an actionable service problem to the owner or actual parent
      --allow-net            with --html: let the card load images, fonts, scripts and data over HTTPS
      --attach stringArray   attach a file (repeatable)
      --forward string       id of a post in the room to forward; the text becomes your note
  -h, --help                 help for post
      --html string          attach one .html file as a desktop card (needs post text)
      --json                 print the stored post and each delivery as JSON
      --reply-to string      post id this replies to
      --update string        with --html: add a new version to the visual this post ID created
---SCRATCH---
DYNA_SCRATCH=/tmp/dyna/ses_20261019-121505-4e32139e
